doc.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003

title: Opening and Sonny's oversized drumstick
summary: Monk Rowe opens the interview at Sonny Igoe's home in Emerson, NJ, and they joke about a giant drumstick from a closed percussion store.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Emerson, New Jersey. I’m very pleased to be speaking with Sonny Igoe today for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College.
It’s a real pleasure to be here amongst your memorabilia.
Well I told you it would be a mess.
I see a rather large drumstick back there. Is that special for students who don’t quite do their flams?

Well you would think I could really club them with this, wouldn’t you? But this is from a store that went out of business in New York called Professional Percussion. And one of the fellas who worked there was taking lessons with me so he brought me — I don’t know what happened to the other one, maybe I broke it on somebody.
